versions.changelog: Fix: run in main session instead of subagent. Browser tool only works in main session.

- Initial release of gemini-deep-research-notion.
- Launches Gemini Deep Research in the browser and exports results to Notion with a single trigger.
- Spawns a subagent to fully automate research, extraction, and export—main session only kicks off the process.
- Ensures research is performed in Chinese and exported to a designated Notion page as structured blocks.
- Handles status polling, result extraction, and error handling, including user notification on completion or failure.
